guidance.statement: Aiming for mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.
guidance.quote: We are looking at mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.statement: Anticipate that the gap between volume and value will remain in the 4-5% zone.
guidance.quote: we would anticipate that the gap between the volume and the value would remain in that zone of about 4-5%.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.statement: Maintain the PBDIT margin band of 18 to 20%.
guidance.quote: it is okay to maintain the whole guidance of 18 to 20% PBDIT margin band.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

growth_commentary: Delivered a volume growth of 10.9% and value growth of 6% in Q2 FY26.
Driven by heavy brand spending, new product innovation, and regionalization initiatives.
Supported by good performance in the Prelux category in emulsions and strong international and industrial businesses.
Raw material prices remained benign with deflation of 1.6% in Q2.

pushback.question: What has been your reaction to the 10% free grammage in different SKUs by a competitor, and is intensity waning?
pushback.answer: Asian Paints focuses on fundamentals, brand building, and premium/luxury finishes rather than just discounting, which reduces retailer turnover.

pushback.question: Why is the volume-value gap lower than historical trends, and will it reduce?
pushback.answer: A balanced approach across economy, mid-level, and luxury segments is maintained to avoid losing out in large volume categories like economy.

pushback.question: Given benign raw material costs, are you comfortable landing at the higher end of the 18-20% margin band?
pushback.answer: Management is comfortable maintaining the 18-20% band given meaningful investments in marketing, technology, and higher competitive intensity.
